frames.observation: Inventory PATRON OF LOST CAUSES nameplate, long silver casing, narrow optic, gold barrel/internal tube, black open triangular stock and forward underside hook. Identity only.
Empty HUD0 after firing; receiver near hip before reload.
Empty HUD0, support hand still forward; pre-lift.
Reload onset: support hand leaves forward contact toward rear magazine.
Support hand reaches toward bullpup rear underside as receiver begins rising.
Steep muzzle-up lift at right edge; rear stock and rear magazine region presented.
Near-vertical receiver hold; hand/screen edge occludes outgoing magazine exchange.
Steep hold continues; support hand returning beneath rear magazine socket.
Replacement approach at rear underside; hand partly covers magazine body.
Magazine seated: HUD15/reserve94; support hand begins opening under stock.
Receiver lowers sharply; support hand moves forward along body. No isolated bolt stroke measurable.
Receiver near hip; support palm continues forward recovery.
Small low overshoot after rapid lowering; magazine seated.
Hip recovery with open support fingers leaving sight line.
Ready hip silhouette recovered, complete magazine seated.
Post-reload ready hip; same scope and receiver.
